title: Mock2 operator-verification evidence (mock2_integration_verifications row)
description: Append-only, hash-linked confirmation that an implemented real integration was verified against the live external system (or an admin waiver). Historical rows are never mutated; a superseding reverification inserts a new row with supersedes_id. Operators confirm; admins waive.

manifest_hash.description: content hash of the manifest entry — a change supersedes this record

operator_id.description: the confirming operator or waiving admin

environment.description: where verification was performed, e.g. production, staging

observed_result.description: REQUIRED for a confirmation — the actual observation (status, sample volume, endpoint). A bare checkbox value (true/ok/yes/done) is invalid.

expires_at.description: reverification trigger; supersession fires at/after this time

supersedes_id.description: the verification row this reverification replaces (append-only supersession)
